test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

For twenty years you hold an innocent and __**virtuous**__ woman under an infamous suspicion.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unethical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"virtuous"** means having or showing high moral standards; righteous and good. (नैतिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She lived a virtuous life, always helping others and staying true to her values.
 
 
 
• **"Unethical" **refers to behavior that is morally wrong or unacceptable; lacking principles. (अनैतिक)
 
 
• **Example: **His unethical business practices eventually led to his downfall.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'virtuous' **is **'unethical'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unethical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Blameless **(निर्दोष): Free from or not deserving blame.

 
 
• **Example:** The jury found him blameless in the accident, as he was not at fault.
 
 
 
• **Moral **(नैतिक): Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **She is known for her strong moral convictions and integrity.
 
 
 
• **Righteous** (धार्मिक): Morally right or justifiable; virtuous.
 
 
• **Example:** His righteous actions earned him the respect of his peers.
